notes.title: Update 2018-04-23
notes.notes:
[b]Changes[/b]
- Added vibration in controllers when mines explode
- Changed the look of the teleport-cursor

[b]Bugfixes[/b]
- Multiplayer-screen was cut off at the top, camera alignment is now fixed

notes.title: Available now!
notes.notes:
Today is the day that you can purchase MineSweepVR on Steam. Play the renowned classic, minesweeper, now in virtual reality. Put on your VR-headset and find yourself on the minefield. Locate the mines and mark them with a flag. Find all the mines and improve your times. Are you ready for a greater challenge? Then you can also play together with your friends. One of you dives into the virtual world, while the others have the clues on where to place the flags.

What are you waiting for? Buy it now!
